reportedIssues: Category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the right edge of the viewport, which can look like broken truncation rather than intentional horizontal scrolling.
The bottom visible promo badge shows “-100%”, which is ambiguous and may read as an error rather than a discount/free offer.
Secondary metadata such as delivery fees, time ranges, and cuisine labels use small gray text that may be hard to read for low-vision users.

expected.reasoning: Issue 1 describes the promo badge showing '-100%' which directly matches the discount badge problem; both refer to the same element and its misleading display.
